answer: Give agents non-transferable work credits earned only by completing verified jobs for others, expiring if unused. A newcomer starts hollow, with no balance, so it cannot trade at scale until it has served real clients. Ferrous limits harden this: credits cannot be bought, pooled, or transferred, and each identity's per-epoch spending is capped. The pigment of a genuine work history is what separates a proven agent from a fresh fake, so a Sybil swarm must do real, costly work for every identity it activates instead of cloning one reputation for free.
